artifacts.summary: 7-phase rollout of a frozen canonical .orchestrator-handoff.json obligation block across 61 of the 64 dispatch[]-reachable agent contracts (55 additive, 6 prohibition reversals, 2 verify-only).

memory_candidates.content: In /orchestrate, an agent named by a manifest's routing_agents block (a dispatch[] row) can ALSO be reached via an aux_dispatch[] row: orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's aux_fixed_agent() resolves the divergence-audit kind to research_agents[$t] (default general-research-agent), while emitting orchestrator_mode:false and no handoff_path key. So 'dispatch[]-reachable' and 'aux-dispatched' are not disjoint agent sets. The consequence for contract authoring: any per-agent obligation that must hold for dispatch[] but not aux_dispatch[] should be conditioned on the presence of orchestrator_mode:true (or handoff_path) rather than stated as an unconditional agent-level rule, because the same agent file serves both call paths. Conditioning makes the aux exemption structural and removes the need to restate the aux contract in every agent file.
